# Collective Work Thresholds

This repository studies the jointly controlled block size needed for useful mean ergotropy near a positive-temperature Gibbs state. The model is a fixed finite nonconstant commensurate Hamiltonian, a known positive diagonal C2 input path through the Gibbs state with a nonzero first-order component transverse to the Gibbs-temperature direction, independent copies, and arbitrary system-only cyclic unitaries.

## Core result

First activation requires Theta(delta^-1) copies; a fixed 25% thermodynamic yield requires Theta(delta^-2). A passive-reference relative-entropy inequality proves W_n <= A(1+B n delta^2) exp[-c/(n delta^2)] uniformly over all unitaries in the small-block window. Constants depend on the fixed system and path.

- Scientific overview and routes: README.md.
- Single educational anchor and notation/assumption bridge: learning/WATROUS_BRIDGE.md, using John Watrous, The Theory of Quantum Information (2018).
- Common understanding map, exactly M01 through M30 in two project-defined phases: learning/MILESTONES.md.
- Definitions, quantifiers and transverse coefficient: science/model.md.
- Normalized clipping, common observable order and all-unitary converse: science/passive_clipping.md.
- Integer activation witness and safe exponential-work window: science/activation.md.
- Explicit finite extraction certificate, type multiplicities, Bezout rounding, residue mixing and quarter-yield construction: science/useful_work.md.
- Exact odd-integer qutrit onset and strict-tie counterexample: science/qutrit.md.
- Mean work, control resources and essential hypothesis boundaries: science/interpretation.md.
- Inherited tools, closest literature and concurrent project overlap: references/RELATED_WORK.md.
- Structured citations: references/references.bib.
- Cancellation-free finite qutrit rearrangement, checked cases and exactness limits: verification/README.md, verification/ergotropy_validate.py and verification/checked_cases.json.

## Connected routes

For the physical story, read README.md, the qutrit swap in learning/WATROUS_BRIDGE.md, science/model.md and science/interpretation.md. For a structured study route, start with learning/WATROUS_BRIDGE.md and follow the dependencies in learning/MILESTONES.md into the authoritative scientific pages. Watrous is the sole educational anchor; the research bibliography supplies attribution, not an additional prerequisite curriculum.

For theorem verification, read science/model.md, science/passive_clipping.md, science/activation.md and science/useful_work.md, then check the boundaries in science/interpretation.md and references/RELATED_WORK.md. For numerical reproduction, use verification/README.md and its documented commands; numerical examples do not prove the general threshold.

## Preserve these distinctions

The theorem bounds joint block size, not gate complexity, charging time, power or reliable-work sample complexity. It excludes coherent inputs and Hamiltonians varying with the perturbation parameter. An exact first inversion can be arbitrarily close to a tie, so the matched exponential lower work estimate applies only at a fixed factor beyond onset. Degeneracies are allowed. No monotonicity of yield per copy, universal crossover constant or arbitrary near-total yield is assumed.

The equal-entropy Gibbs endpoint, type-transport methods, statistical inverse-square scale and ordering-preserving passivity tools are inherited. The concurrent Quantum-Work-Activation note shares the rational-qutrit task and clipping mechanism. The quantitative addition here is the bandwidth-free converse, exact threshold, specified quarter yield and general finite commensurate C2 scope. Its irrational-spectrum branch is not a dependency of this account.
